title: Custom Cosmetic Packaging Dubai GCC RFQ Preparation Source Card
checklist: Define product dimensions, quantity, delivery city, timeline and finish direction before requesting a quote.
Clarify whether the item is for skincare, fragrance, beauty set, retail shelf or e-commerce use.
Ask suppliers to review structure, insert needs, surface finish and artwork before production pricing.
Keep regulatory and product-claim questions separate from packaging structure questions.
Review public product and process pages before sending supplier RFQs.
prompt: For a Dubai and GCC B2B buyer looking for custom cosmetic packaging, what should a buyer prepare before requesting a quote or RFQ, and which public source pages are useful? Cite sources.
